question: If I like vegetables, which do you recommend I try?
output_text:

• Rating: 4.9 stars (818 reviews)
• Highlights: An iconic all-vegan sandwich spot specializing in freshly prepared vegetable sandwiches, subs, and fresh sides.

2. Rawtopia Living Cuisine and Beyond (Millcreek — 3961 S Wasatch Dr)
• Rating: 4.8 stars (495 reviews)
• Highlights: Fine-dining focused on organic, living, raw produce, vegetable entrées, sprouted grain dishes, and cold-pressed juices.

3. Vegan Bowl (West Jordan — 8672 S Redwood Rd)
• Rating: 4.8 stars (628 reviews)
• Highlights: Asian and Vietnamese plant-based comfort food packed with fresh vegetables, herbs, noodle bowls, and simmered broths.

4. Cafe Shambala (Salt Lake City — 382 E 4th Ave)
• Rating: 4.8 stars (418 reviews)
• Highlights: Tibetan vegetarian fare featuring vegetable momos, spinach curries, and sautéed mountain greens.

5. Mahider Ethiopian Restaurant & Market (Salt Lake City — 1465 State St)
• Rating: 4.7 stars (608 reviews)
• Highlights: Traditional Ethiopian veggie platters featuring stewed lentils (misir wot), collard greens (gomen), cabbage, and carrots served over sourdough injera.

Note: Like 98.4% of establishments in the local database, Buds and several of these venues do not have a matched SLCHD health inspection record on file, but they maintain exceptional review track records.

  AND e.num_of_reviews >= 100
ORDER BY e.avg_rating DESC, e.num_of_reviews DESC
LIMIT 15;
